thread:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — SI launch with Nebula partner tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need a final, concise partner SEV path: shared Slack channel -> who pagers -> when we spin up warroom? Also marketplace listing contacts for postmortem comms. Anyone on final runbook?
kevin (eng-sre): +1. Proposal: shared-channel with read-only partner account, SEV classification in thread. If SEV2 persists >15m after mitigation step 1, escalate to warroom and @oncall-page. Put runbook here: https://redwood.docs/partner-escalation
sam (eng-oncall): Suggest we add DM to partner-liaison in first 5 mins and send pager if customer impact. For warroom, use dedicated bridge (#warroom-nebula) and post triage template. Template quick snippet:
```
- Impact: <service>
- Start: <time>
- Initial mitigation tried: <steps>
- Owner: <liaison>
```
jamie (solutions): I'll own the liaison handoff for Nebula. I'll add primary/backup contacts and our marketplace PM contacts. Also recommend we add a "ticket owner" field visible to partner.
alex (product): Make sure we document automatic fallback routing: hosted -> dedicated -> private variant. That reduces blast radius and should be in SLA comms.
maria (partnerships): OK jamie can you drop contact table in the doc and ping ops-bot to create the shared channel with partner account before start?
jamie (solutions): on it. I'll drop contact table and a checklist (triage, escalate, warroom, postmortem). Will include role matrix: partner-liaison, eng-oncall, sres, marketplace-pm.
ops-bot: Created shared channel #nebula-partner-bridge and scheduled warroom bridge if escalated.
kevin (eng-sre): one more: add alert thresholds in ops config: sev1 -> immediate warroom; sev2 -> warroom if >15m unresolved after mitigations; sev3 -> handled in-thread. Also add reroute policy for quant workloads and a circuit-breaker throttle for heavy batched jobs.
maria (partnerships): great. can we run a quick dry-run 30m before launch? want to rehearse handoff and warroom creation.
sam (eng-oncall): I can run the dry-run. I'll post a short checklist in the channel 30m prior.
maria (partnerships): awesome — thanks team :raised_hands:
